name: aiPHeed provincial food-price pressure forecast (E53 arm R0, experimental)
status: EXPERIMENTAL - development evidence, not independently validated; enabled only with AIPHEED_LEAD2_MODEL=e53
modelVersion: E53-R0 = E46-I7 price component (E53 protocol sha 4d2e14966dd8f76a)

information.rule: only data published before the origin

indicator.name: Food-Price Pressure Probability (experimental)
indicator.definition: Probability that the province's food-price pressure signal is on in the target quarter (target PS): PSA food inflation (quarter mean, year on year) above the province's 2021-2022 60th percentile, or food minus headline inflation above its 2021-2022 60th percentile. Estimated by the E53 food-price-pressure model. Food-price pressure is not hunger and not verified household food insecurity.
indicator.horizon: Lead 2: issued 2026-10-01 (latest completed quarter 2026-Q3) for 2027-Q1; experimental (E53)
indicator.source: PSA provincial food and headline CPI and wholesale rice; typhoon tracks and ENSO; PSA production; PSA LFS (national); BSP remittances and ECB USD/PHP (national); news; official rice-policy orders
indicator.caveat: Food-price pressure, not food insecurity. Development evidence only (E53), not independently validated. Indicative decision support only.

scoreTypes.food_price_pressure_probability: Probability that the province's food-price pressure signal is on in the target quarter (target PS): PSA food inflation (quarter mean, year on year) above the province's 2021-2022 60th percentile, or food minus headline inflation above its 2021-2022 60th percentile. Estimated by the E53 food-price-pressure model. Food-price pressure is not hunger and not verified household food insecurity.

attributionMethod: Log-odds change of the served probability when each trigger group's inputs are set to their training mean, all else fixed. Market / Prices includes the projected food inflation and gap built from PSA CPI and the rice-policy orders; each group includes its own news share; total news volume is reported as other. Model attributions, not causes.

operationalRules.band: Low if P < 0.33; Watch if 0.33 <= P < 0.67; High if P >= 0.67
operationalRules.alert: Alert candidate when the band is High; staged for administrator confirmation.
operationalRules.municipal: No municipal probability; LGU rankings are relative prioritization.
